notes.title: Development Update! Introducing Scorched Sands
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156375/a7953a7fb1426343dbaa56f914f8910d599ab351.jpg[/img]

With this quote from Iron Maiden’s song "Nomad," we’d like to share a few things about the location where you’ll be managing one of your festivals - [b]Scorched Sands[/b]. This land is filled with ruins of ancient empires and tombs of past civilizations, reminders of the greatness this place once held. Now, it struggles to survive an ecological disaster, making life incredibly harsh for the locals. 

Two opposing continents are divided by local conflicts, and it’s up to the player to decide which faction will rule the region. And what better weapon for this battle than [b]heavy metal[/b] itself? Your festival will feature unique buildings to elevate the experience and ensure maximum comfort for visitors. Bands from across the globe are ready to take the stage - but are you?

You’ll get the chance to prove it soon! On our part, we’re working hard, putting all our passion and experience into delivering the best gaming experience for you. Stay tuned - more details and concepts are coming soon! But for now, wishlist the game on Steam and remember - [b]it’s still a work in progress[/b]. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/bScVuh3NkT]Discord server[/url] and follow us on social media, metalhead!
